Play in the browser](https://sekor.eu.org/2049/) [](/skorotkiewicz/2049/blob/main/assets/screenshot.png) 💻 also runs in the browser (uv run gameweb) [](/skorotkiewicz/2049/blob/main/assets/screenshotweb.png) A tiny roguelike that fuses 2048 and Minesweeper. You _are_ the tile: every move slides the whole dungeon with 2048 rules while hidden mines Minesweeper style wait in the dark. Descend 8 depths and escape. Run uv run game No dependencies beyond Python itself; everything is managed by uv. Run in the browser uv run gameweb Serves web/ and opens your browser. The same core.py runs in the browser via [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org) (Python → WebAssembly, loaded from CDN on first visit); the frontend is plain HTML/CSS/JS with the same 2048 palette. Works on touch screens too just swipe. How it works 2048 half \ every move slides _all_ tiles (you included). Slide into an equal tile to merge: your power doubles, score goes up. Big merges (32+) heal you. Minesweeper half \ mines are invisible and act as walls for tiles (tiles piling up against nothing is itself a clue). Standing next to cells _probes_ them: mines get flagged with , safe cells show a clue number = how many mines touch them. Stepping on any mine explodes it for 1 + depth damage. Roguelike half \ find the stairs to descend. Each depth adds mines. Run out of moves and the walls crush you. Die and your score is all that remains. Reach depth 8 and climb out to win. Controls Key Action arrows / h j k l slide up / down / left / right r new run q quit Best score is saved locally localStorage in the browser, ~/.config/2049/best.json in the terminal. Layout src/game/ ├── core.py game state, 2048 slide, mines, probing, descent ├── ui.py ANSI board renderer (no deps) ├── input.py raw keypress input (POSIX + Windows) └── main.py main loop About 2049 a roguelike that fuses 2048 and Minesweeper [sekor.eu.org/2049](https://sekor.eu.org/2049) Resources [Readme](readmeovfile) [MIT license](MIT1ovfile) [Activity](/skorotkiewicz/2049/activity) Stars 0 stars Watchers 0 watching Forks [0 forks](/skorotkiewicz/2049/forks) [Report repository](/contact/reportcontent?content%5Furl=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fskorotkiewicz%2F2049&report=skorotkiewicz+%28user%29) Contributors Languages You can’t perform that action at this time.
items.author: modinfo
items.descZh: 2049是一款创新的roguelike游戏，由开发者skorotkiewicz在GitHub上发布，它巧妙融合了2048的滑动合并机制和扫雷的隐藏地雷探测玩法。核心功能中，玩家扮演一个方块，每次移动会滑动整个地牢，遵循2048规则合并相同方块以提升分数和能力，同时需要像扫雷一样探测隐藏的地雷，避免爆炸。游戏亮点包括需要下降8个深度才能逃脱，大合并（32+）能治疗玩家，踩到地雷会造成1+深度的伤害，这些具体数字增强了策略深度。适用场景方面，游戏适合喜欢roguelike元素和逻辑解谜的玩家，可在终端或浏览器中运行，基于Python编写，通过uv管理依赖，无需额外安装，提供简洁的触摸支持。整体而言，它结合了经典游戏的紧张感，适合短时间娱乐或深度挑战。
items.quote: 一款融合 2048 和扫雷的微型 Roguelike 游戏。

It records five things that are easy to lose between an earlier session and a later action: 1. Source — where the information came from. 2. Observed time — when it was last checked. 3. Scope — the work, person, or project it applies to. 4. Proposed action — the bounded step being considered. 5. Review decision — whether the context is current, stale, or needs a person to resolve it. The JSON Schema in [contextfreshnessledger.schema.json](/chengyixu/contextfreshnessledger/blob/main/contextfreshnessledger.schema.json)is intentionally narrow. It does not access accounts, call tools, send messages, infer permissions, or authorize an external action. It is a format for a reviewable record, not a compliance or security certification. Example { "record_id": "vendorquote202608", "source": { "kind": "document", "reference": "approvedvendorquote.pdf", "observed_at": "20260820T09:30:00Z" }, "scope": "procurement / packaging refresh", "proposed_action": "prepare a renewal draft", "freshness": { "review_by": "20260827T09:30:00Z", "status": "stale", "reason": "The quote expired before the draft would be sent." }, "human_return": { "required": true, "reason": "A current quote and an external commitment require review." } } Related prelaunch direction I work on Klik. It is a prelaunch, appfirst, recorderagnostic proactiveAI direction for turning deliberate Sessions into useful Context and permissionaware followthrough. New access, material judgment, and external commitments stay with the person. This reference is an independent educational format, not a product release, integration guarantee, benchmark, performance claim, or statement that every source or recorder is supported. Learn more: <https://pre.hiklik.ai/?utm%5Fsource=github&utm%5Fmedium=developer%5Fresource&utm%5Fcampaign=kickstarter%5Fprelaunch&utm%5Fcontent=context%5Ffreshness%5Fledger Further reading: [An AI Meeting Note Is Not a FollowUp: Five Checks Before Context Becomes an External Action](https://gist.github.com/chengyixu/47faf7721b0912f2f1069b89d5181e25) Discover Klik: <https://pre.hiklik.ai/ About A small JSON Schema reference for reviewable agentcontext freshness decisions. items.author: Wilson_Xu
items.descZh: Context Freshness Ledger 是一个轻量级且无需执行的 JSON Schema 参考框架，专为解决 AI 代理在跨会话中记忆信息的新鲜度决策问题而设计。其核心功能是结构化记录信息来源、观测时间、适用范围、拟执行动作以及审查决策（如新鲜、陈旧或需人工裁决）等五个关键维度。该规范的最大亮点在于其极简与安全性，明确声明不访问账户、不调用工具、不发送消息，仅作为可审计的记录格式，绝无外部授权副作用。它特别适用于需要严格治理上下文生命周期的业务场景，例如在报价单过期或准备外部承诺时，确保 AI 的下一步动作基于最新且经审核的数据。该项目作为一个独立的教育性格式规范，为构建具有权限感知和主动性的 AI 系统（如 Klik 方向）提供了高可审计性的上下文治理参考。
items.quote: 上下文新鲜度账本是一个小型的、无需执行的参考，用于判断已记住的信息是否仍适用于拟议的下一步。

Format and CLI may change between minor versions. The integrity guarantees below are implemented and tested; there has been no external security audit. Undo as infrastructure. respawn versions the state of a directory tree as a contentaddressed snapshot graph — every file's content lives in the store, so any snapshot can be materialized back exactly. Reverting is a HEAD pointer swap plus atomic perfile writes. Drift is a manifest diff. Machines replicate snapshots over the LAN with no server. Built for the agent era: snapshot the world before an autonomous process touches it, revert when it goes wrong, and prove afterward what changed. respawn init create .respawn/ in the worktree respawn snap m "v1" contentaddressed snapshot respawn status drift vs HEAD (added/modified/deleted) respawn status full rehash every file — don't trust metadata respawn diff v1 head compare two snapshots respawn revert <id materialize a snapshot (atomic per file) respawn log snapshot history respawn verify audit chain + object integrity respawn serve announce serve objects to LAN peers (loopback default) respawn peers discover announcing peers respawn pull host:4789 replicate a peer's history locally What it actually guarantees Content integrity. Every object is BLAKE3addressed and verified on read, on reconstruction during revert, and on receipt during sync. A corrupted or tampered object is detected, never silently used. Atomic perfile revert. Files are written to a temp file and renamed over the destination. A crash midrevert can leave a partiallyapplied snapshot (some files new, some old) but never a halfwritten file. Tamperevident audit. Every mutation appends to a hashchained audit.jsonl. verify detects edited, deleted, or reordered entries. Replication without trust. Peers serve raw objects; the receiver rehashes before storing, validates manifest structure before use, and never lets wire data reach the worktree. A malicious peer cannot poison your store or write outside it — worst case, it wastes your bandwidth (chain length, object count, and frame size are all capped). Revert cannot escape the worktree. Manifest paths are validated on load and revalidated at the write boundary; absolute paths and .. components are rejected, symlinked ancestors block the write, and modes are masked to 0o777 so setuid bits never propagate. What it does not guarantee (honest limits) Filesystem state only. Processes, memory, app state, and file permissions beyond POSIX mode bits are not captured. "Machine state" is a v0.2+ question, not a v0.1 claim. Revert is O(changed files), not O(1). The HEAD swap is constanttime; materializing content is proportional to what differs. For large trees the honest cost model is "pay for what changed." Fixed 64 KiB chunks. Dedup is perchunk, so a 1byte edit to a file rewrites one chunk — fine — but contentdefined chunking (better dedup on inserts) is not implemented yet. Audit detects tampering, not history rewriting. An attacker with write access to .respawn/ can replace the whole log; the chain only proves the log you have is internally consistent. External anchors (signed checkpoints) are future work — see sovereign\_ledger for the model. LAN sync is plaintext and unauthenticated. Objects are selfverifying, so integrity is safe on a hostile network, but _confidentiality_ is not — anyone who can reach the listener can read snapshotted content. serve binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and warns on any other address; only bind wider on a network you trust. Encrypted, authenticated transport is planned. Drift's fast path trusts metadata. status skips hashing files whose size and mtime match the manifest — an attacker able to write your files can als
items.author: savag3AZfckk
items.descZh: respawn 是一个处于 beta 开发阶段的文件系统版本控制工具，专为自主进程（如 AI 代理）设计，旨在提供可靠的撤销与审计能力。它通过内容寻址快照技术将目录树状态版本化，支持原子性撤销、漂移检测以及无需信任的 LAN 同步。核心亮点包括基于 BLAKE3 的内容完整性验证，确保每个对象在读取、重建和同步时都被校验，杜绝静默使用损坏数据；原子性逐个文件写入机制保证即使崩溃也不会留下半写入文件；防篡改的哈希链审计日志可检测条目编辑、删除或重排。性能方面，撤销操作的成本与变化的文件数成正比，而非固定开销，结合固定 64 KiB 块去重，适合大型文件树的高效处理。适用场景主要是需要审计和快速恢复文件系统状态的开发环境，特别是自主进程可能引入错误的场合。
items.quote: 专为智能体时代打造：在自主进程触及世界之前对其进行快照，在出错时进行恢复，并在事后证明发生了什么变化。
items.titleZh: Show HN: Respawn – 内容寻址的文件系统快照与撤销 (Rust)

Explore the Sudoku Galaxy: visualize puzzles, share codes, and discover solving techniques. title: Ukodus Sudoku Galaxy image: https://ukodus.now/assets/oghome.png Rust engine · WASM · Galaxy Sudoku Galaxy A living constellation of puzzles. Every game you play becomes a star in the galaxy — connected by shared techniques, clustered by difficulty, and growing with each solve. Explore thousands of unique puzzles, see how they relate, and find your next challenge. 46 solving techniques 8 difficulty tiers Share via short codes Live galaxy updates [ Play Now](/play/) [Explore Galaxy](/galaxy/) A universe of puzzles, visualized. Every puzzle is a data point. The Galaxy maps them by technique, difficulty, and player activity — revealing patterns in the puzzle space. Galaxy Visualization An interactive forcedirected graph where each node is a puzzle. Clusters form around shared solving techniques. Zoom, pan, and click to explore. Crossplatform Sharing Share any puzzle with an 8character code like M1A2B3C4. Works across the web app, iOS, and terminal UI — same engine, same puzzle. Technique Explorer Filter the galaxy by solving technique: from simple singles to advanced chains and forcing patterns. See which techniques cluster together. Available on iOS The same Rust engine compiled to native code. Fast puzzles, humanstyle hints, Game Center leaderboards, and iCloud sync. [ Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sudoku/id6758485043) [See demos & details](/app/) How it works The Rust engine rates each puzzle using 46 catalogued solving techniques and an SEinspired engine score. The Galaxy API collects anonymous play results and builds the constellation in real time. Play a puzzle Start a game at any difficulty tier. The WASM engine generates a unique puzzle with a guaranteed single solution. Results flow in When you finish, anonymous play data (time, difficulty, technique profile) is sent to the Galaxy API. items.descZh: Ukodus 是一个基于共享 Rust 引擎（支持 WASM 和原生编译）的开源免费数独平台，致力于将数独游戏构建为一个互联的可视化宇宙。其核心功能包括“数独星系”交互式图谱、跨平台 8 位代码分享，以及基于 46 种解题技巧和 8 个难度等级的精准过滤与谜题生成。平台亮点在于其庞大的解题技巧库（覆盖 10 大家族，远超同类应用仅 5 至 15 种的水平），并结合类似 SE 的引擎评分系统提供带逻辑证明的渐进式提示。玩家在星系中的每一次游玩都会化身为一颗实时更新的节点，通过 WebSocket 动态聚类并连接，无需注册且无追踪。该平台特别适合追求高难度技巧解析、跨端（Web、iOS 及终端）无缝同步，且热衷于在可视化数据空间中探索数独规律的深度玩家。

items.author: AEndrix03
items.descZh: 针对AI编码助手在长期多会话开发中容易遗忘历史修复、技术决策和项目上下文的痛点，Graft提供了一套本地优先（Local-first）的持久化记忆解决方案。它支持跨Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT及Gemini CLI等多种Agent工作流，自动记忆并复用关键的修复方案与项目知识。Graft的核心完全运行在本地，基于C11、SQLite、sqlitevec、FTS5、BGEM3和llama.cpp等高性能技术栈构建，无需SaaS、外部API或密钥，确保了极致的数据隐私与离线能力。通过混合检索与图探索技术，Graft能在遇到同类问题时迅速提供经过验证的上下文，避免开发者和AI重复解决相同难题。该工具特别适合需要长期维护复杂项目、追求高效迭代且高度关注代码与数据本地安全的开发团队及个人。
items.quote: 持久的本地记忆，在需要时找回修复方案、决策和项目知识——跨 Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT 及更多。
items.titleZh: Show HN: Graft – 面向编程智能体的本地优先持久化记忆
